resources.string: Note: Android will show a general warning about notification access. This app only processes Google Maps notifications and your music status – everything else is discarded immediately. The app has no internet permission and therefore cannot pass anything on.
Access granted, the service is being restarted… If this message stays, allow autostart or switch access off and on again (see Help)
Autostart is not allowed – without it your phone stops the app in the background and the display stays empty. If the switch for Drive Assistant already shows on: switch it off and on again.

Getting started with Drive Assistant
1. Allow notification access (button under step 1).
2. Switch on the Drive Assistant and pair it once when the app asks ("Pair Drive Assistant"). From then on the app connects automatically, even while it is closed. If that does not happen, tap "Search & connect Drive Assistant".
3. Start navigation in Google Maps – the Drive Assistant automatically shows the turn arrow, distance and street.

One-time settings (important – otherwise the display stays empty!)

• Allow autostart: Settings → Apps → Drive Assistant → enable "Autostart" (if your phone offers this setting). Otherwise the system stops the notification service in the background.

• Don\'t restrict battery: Settings → Apps → Drive Assistant → Battery → choose "No restrictions". This keeps the app running while the screen is off.

• Allow Google Maps notifications: Settings → Apps → Google Maps → Notifications → enable "Navigation". The app reads the turn information from exactly this notification – if it is off, nothing arrives.

Good to know

• The Android warning when granting notification access is a general system notice. The app only processes Google Maps notifications and your music status; it has no internet permission and therefore cannot pass anything on.

• The notification "Drive Assistant active" only appears while the device is connected. It keeps the app alive during the ride so the system does not stop it. Please do not disable it.

• The app restarts its notification service by itself if the system stopped it. If step 1 keeps saying "service is being restarted" (or the display stays empty despite everything): allow autostart, then switch notification access OFF and ON again (button under step 1).

• Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones reset the autostart permission after every app update. The app notices this and shows an "Allow autostart" button that takes you straight to the switch.

• If the connection drops (e. g. the device was switched off and on again), the app reconnects by itself. If it does not, tap "Search & connect" – the manual way always works. Without a connection the Drive Assistant shows the wait screen.

• "Disconnect" pauses the automatic connection. It is re-enabled the next time you open the app or tap "Search & connect".

• After switching Bluetooth off and on or restarting the phone, open the app once so the automatic connection is active again.

• Tip: lock the app in the recent-apps overview (lock icon on the app card). Then "close all" no longer stops it during a ride. If it does get stopped, the app reconnects by itself as soon as the device is visible again.

• "Send test packet" only checks the radio link to the Drive Assistant – Google Maps is not needed for it.
Pair once so your phone starts the app by itself as soon as you switch on the Drive Assistant. The Drive Assistant must be switched on for this.
Paired – connects automatically from now on
